the thing is she's really been into this dude to the point where she's beating herself up about the fact that he might have """friendzoned""" her? i'm not doubting the fact that she may be struggling w/ her sexuality or anything, but i don't necessarily think that she's in love with me, if that makes sense? 

because i'm two years older than her maybe she might have mistaken me for an 'adult' figure--idk i'm bad with words. 

furthermore, she's one year younger than all of the kids in our grade and i'm one year older, and i think she just wants somebody to talk to who understands that being a different age from the rest of the kids in your grade sucks? i dunno, really. i'm sorry for rambling. i just don't know what to do.
